newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound o/n rates slip in liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound o/n rates slip in liquid market.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell on Tuesday to between six and 8-1/8 percent in a liquid private sector market, compared with Monday's range of 7-1/2 and 8-1/2 percent, brokers said.
Most bankers said they did not make one-week deals but one put the rate at seven percent. Some bankers on Monday put one-week rates at between 8 and 9-1/2 percent.
Bankers said public sector banks had kept their minimum lending rate steady at 10-1/2 percent.
